exposure: Control group (4:1 matched) without circumvallate placentas
Pregnant people with prenatally diagnosed circumvallate placentas
Prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of circumvallate placenta
outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (antenatal bleeding, placental abruption, preterm birth, emergency cesarean, small for gestational age infants, and stillbirth)
cohort: Pregnancies with singleton gestations prenatally diagnosed with circumvallate placenta
finding: Prenatal ultrasound findings of circumvallate placenta were not associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis: 19.8 +/- 2.4 weeks
